recall.//: Combo-recall RATCHET gate (alignment initiative 04). Re-runs the bench over the pinned Spellbook snapshot + gold corpus and compares to the committed bench-report.json: FAILS if recall@Green or recall@(Green+Amber) DECREASED; auto-rewrites the baseline on an increase/detail-drift (commit the updated bench-report.json). Run at mast-tdd-loop Step 8.

recall:write.//: Reseed bench-report.json from current behavior, after a DELIBERATE recall change (e.g. initiative 06). Use only when the change is judge-reviewed; the ratchet otherwise advances the baseline itself on improvement.
